versus.helpText: Agregati: count(), countIf(condition), sum(x), sumIf(x, condition), avg(x), min(x), max(x), median(x), percentile(x, 90), stdev(x), distinct(column), presence() (sekunde), players(), matches(), rounds(), kills(), deaths(), winRate(). Stopnje: perMinute(v), perMatch(v), perRound(v), perPlayer(v), ofAll(v) (delež vrstice Vse), shrink(a, b, 4) (a / b potegnjeno proti celoti tam, kjer temelji na malo podatkih). Aritmetika + - * / med agregati; pogoji z == != < > and or not in; besedilo v narekovajih. 'where' filtrira vsak agregat: avg(speed) where alt > 1000.
